test_dm_env_implementation: test a dm_env.Environment implementation by inheriting from EnvironmentTestMixin and overriding make_object_under_test
create_action_sequence: create a custom action sequence by overriding make_action_sequence to trigger end-of-episode behavior
validate_timestep: validate a TimeStep against environment specs using assertValidStep to check step_type, reward, discount, and observation
check_spec_conformance: check that a value conforms to an Array spec using assertConformsToSpec for nested numpy arrays
test_episode_lifecycle: test the full episode lifecycle including reset, step sequences, FIRST and LAST step transitions
